statistical.name: statistical_fidelity
statistical.description: Distributional similarity of synthetic and real data: SDV QualityReport plus per-column and pairwise statistics.

metric_descriptions.sdv_quality_score: SDV QualityReport overall score: mean of Column Shapes and Column Pair Trends (1 = identical).
metric_descriptions.sdv_column_shapes: SDV Column Shapes: mean of KSComplement (numeric) and TVComplement (categorical) per column.
metric_descriptions.sdv_column_pair_trends: SDV Column Pair Trends: mean CorrelationSimilarity / ContingencySimilarity over column pairs.
metric_descriptions.sdv_diagnostic_score: SDV DiagnosticReport: data validity (boundary / category adherence) and table structure.
metric_descriptions.ks_statistic: Two-sample Kolmogorov-Smirnov statistic: max distance between the real and synthetic CDFs (0 = identical).
metric_descriptions.wasserstein_normalized: Earth mover's distance between real and synthetic values divided by the real value range.
metric_descriptions.range_coverage: Share of the real [min, max] range covered by the synthetic values.
metric_descriptions.tv_distance: Total variation distance between real and synthetic category frequencies (0 = identical).
metric_descriptions.category_coverage: Share of real categories that appear in the synthetic data.
metric_descriptions.correlation_mean_abs_diff: Mean absolute difference between real and synthetic correlation coefficients over numeric column pairs.
metric_descriptions.cramers_v_mean_abs_diff: Mean absolute difference between real and synthetic Cramér's V over categorical column pairs.
metric_descriptions.column_shapes_score: Mean of 1 - KS (numeric) and 1 - TVD (categorical) over all columns.
metric_descriptions.pair_trends_score: 1 - mean |Δ Spearman| / 2 over numeric column pairs.
metric_descriptions.validity: Share of synthetic rows passing every hard operational rule (bedsynth.validation).

validity.name: validity
validity.description: Share of synthetic rows that satisfy every hard operational rule, with per-rule violation rates.

hard_rules.name: valid_categories
hard_rules.description: ward_id, month, day_of_week, staffing_level and occupancy_level take values from their vocabularies.

hard_rules.name: non_negative_integer_counts
hard_rules.description: Every bed, nurse and patient count (learned and derived) is present, a whole number and not negative.

hard_rules.name: cancellations_within_bookings
hard_rules.description: A ward cannot cancel more elective admissions than were booked for the day.

hard_rules.name: noon_discharges_within_discharges
hard_rules.description: Discharges completed before noon cannot exceed the day's discharges.

hard_rules.name: delayed_within_census
hard_rules.description: Patients medically fit but awaiting discharge at midnight cannot exceed the midnight census.

hard_rules.name: census_within_available_beds
hard_rules.description: The end-of-day census is non-negative and fits within the beds available that day.

hard_rules.name: census_start_within_physical_beds
hard_rules.description: The start-of-day census fits within the base beds plus the escalation beds open.

hard_rules.name: capacity_limits
hard_rules.description: Escalation beds respect the ward's surge limit, closed beds are not negative and at least one bed is available.

hard_rules.name: staffing_present
hard_rules.description: At least one registered nurse is rostered on both the day and the night shift.

hard_rules.name: occupancy_level_consistent
hard_rules.description: The occupancy band matches the midnight occupancy census_end / available_beds.

hard_rules.name: staffing_level_consistent
hard_rules.description: The staffing band matches the day-shift nurses against the ward's nurse requirement.

hard_rules.name: ward_admission_profile
hard_rules.description: Wards that take no elective admissions book none, and wards that take no transfers receive none.

hard_rules.name: metric_ranges
hard_rules.description: Average bed wait (0-96 h), bed turnaround (10-1440 min) and length of stay (0.04-90 days) are physically plausible.

hard_rules.name: wait_definition
hard_rules.description: With no emergency admissions the day's average bed wait is defined as zero.

hard_rules.name: closures_only_free_beds
hard_rules.description: Only free beds are closed, so the start-of-day census fits within the beds available that day.

soft_rules.name: night_staffing_within_day
soft_rules.description: Night-shift nurses do not outnumber day-shift nurses.

soft_rules.name: nurse_workload_plausible
soft_rules.description: Patients per day-shift nurse stay within twice the ward's target nurse ratio.

soft_rules.name: boarding_under_pressure
soft_rules.description: Emergency patients board in ED overnight only when the ward is at least 90% occupied.

soft_rules.name: escalation_under_pressure
soft_rules.description: Escalation beds are open only when the ward is at least 80% occupied.

soft_rules.name: few_weekend_electives
soft_rules.description: At most two elective admissions are booked on a Saturday or Sunday.

soft_rules.name: noon_discharge_share_plausible
soft_rules.description: On days with four or more discharges, at most 80% are completed before noon.

metric_descriptions.hard_valid_rate: Share of rows that pass every hard operational rule (the validity score).
metric_descriptions.hard_violation_rate: Share of rows that violate at least one hard rule.
metric_descriptions.violation_rate: Per rule: share of rows violating that rule.
metric_descriptions.soft_clean_rate: Share of rows that pass every soft (plausibility) rule.

operational.name: operational_patterns
operational.description: Agreement of operational occupancy, scheduling and patient-flow patterns between synthetic and real data (mean of check scores; strata-forced system checks excluded).

calibration.basis: random re-splits of the real data (train + holdout): a pseudo training split vs n rows of the remainder

checks.name: occupancy_mean_by_ward
checks.description: Mean midnight occupancy rate per ward (absolute difference; a 0.10 difference scores 0).
checks.criterion: mean |Δ occupancy| <= 0.03 and every ward reproduced

checks.name: occupancy_distribution_by_ward
checks.description: Distribution of midnight occupancy rate per ward (two-sample KS statistic).
checks.criterion: mean KS <= 0.15 and every ward reproduced

checks.name: occupancy_band_mix_by_ward
checks.description: Mix of occupancy bands (low / normal / high / critical) per ward (total variation distance).
checks.criterion: mean TVD <= 0.10 and every ward reproduced

checks.name: monthly_emergency_profile
checks.description: Monthly profile of mean emergency admissions per ward-day, ward-mix adjusted (seasonal demand shape and level).

checks.name: seasonal_pressure_contrast
checks.description: Winter minus summer share of critical-occupancy ward-days (absolute difference of the contrast).

checks.name: zero_inflated_count_shares
checks.description: Share of ward-days with closed beds, with ED boarders and (on booked days) with cancellations (mean |Δ share|).

checks.name: weekly_elective_profile
checks.description: Day-of-week profile of elective bookings on wards that accept electives (ward-mix adjusted).

checks.name: relationship_bed_pressure_cancellations
checks.description: Spearman correlation of start-of-day bed pressure (census_start / available beds) with the elective cancellation rate on days with bookings.

checks.name: weekly_discharge_profile
checks.description: Day-of-week profile of mean discharges per ward-day (ward-mix adjusted).

checks.name: weekend_weekday_discharge_ratio
checks.description: Mean weekend discharges divided by mean weekday discharges (relative error).

checks.name: before_noon_discharge_share
checks.description: Share of discharges completed before noon (absolute difference).

checks.name: relationship_census_discharges
checks.description: Spearman correlation of start-of-day census with discharges (sign agreement and |Δρ|).

checks.name: relationship_occupancy_boarders
checks.description: Spearman correlation of occupancy rate with emergency patients boarding at midnight.

checks.name: relationship_delays_occupancy
checks.description: Spearman correlation of delayed-discharge rate with occupancy rate.

checks.name: relationship_short_staffing_cancellations
checks.description: Spearman correlation of short staffing (0/1) with elective cancellation rate on days with bookings.

checks.name: relationship_escalation_occupancy
checks.description: Spearman correlation of escalation beds open with occupancy rate.

checks.name: short_staffing_share_by_season
checks.description: Share of short-staffed ward-days per season (absolute difference).
checks.criterion: mean |Δ share| <= 0.05 and every season reproduced

checks.name: boarding_prevalence_by_occupancy_band
checks.description: Share of ward-days with emergency patients boarding at midnight, per occupancy band.
checks.criterion: mean |Δ share| <= 0.05 and every band reproduced

privacy.name: privacy
privacy.description: Protection against copying training records: exact matches and distance to closest record compared with unseen real (holdout) rows.
privacy.note: Reference data is simulated: privacy is assessed methodologically (same checks apply to a real extract).

metric_descriptions.exact_match_rate: Share of synthetic rows identical to a training row on all train columns.
metric_descriptions.holdout_exact_match_rate: Share of real holdout rows identical to a training row (natural duplicate baseline).
metric_descriptions.dcr: Distance to closest training record: mean per-column distance (numeric |Δ|/range, category mismatch = 1).
metric_descriptions.dcr_median_ratio: Median synthetic DCR divided by median holdout DCR (>= 1: synthetic rows are no closer than unseen real rows).
metric_descriptions.close_record_share: Share of synthetic rows closer to the training data than the 5th percentile of holdout DCR (expected 0.05).
metric_descriptions.closer_to_training_share: Share of synthetic rows closer to a training row than to a holdout row, with equally sized reference sets (expected 0.5).
metric_descriptions.exact_match_protection: 1 - excess exact-match rate over the holdout baseline.
metric_descriptions.close_record_protection: 1 - excess close-record share over the expected 0.05 (rescaled to [0, 1]).
metric_descriptions.overfitting_protection: min(1, 2 * (1 - closer-to-training share)) - the DCROverfittingProtection formula.
metric_descriptions.sdmetrics_DCRBaselineProtection: sdmetrics: median synthetic DCR relative to random data (cross-check, not scored).
metric_descriptions.sdmetrics_DCROverfittingProtection: sdmetrics: closer-to-training share converted to a score (cross-check, not scored).
metric_descriptions.aggregate_disclosure: TVD of the synthetic vs training joint mix of the generator's allocation strata, next to the holdout vs training TVD (real noise); a ratio well below 1 means exact training frequencies are reproduced (reported, not scored).

ml_utility.name: ml_utility
ml_utility.description: Train-on-synthetic / test-on-real skill relative to train-on-real with the same number of training rows (HistGradientBoosting, real holdout as test set).

tasks.name: high_pressure_classification
tasks.description: Predict end-of-day high bed pressure from start-of-day information.

tasks.name: discharges_regression
tasks.description: Predict the number of discharges from start-of-day information.

metric_descriptions.trtr: Train-real-test-real: model trained on a seeded real-train subsample of the same size as the synthetic training set, tested on the real holdout (the reference of every ratio).
metric_descriptions.trtr_full: Train-real-test-real on the full real training split (context; reported when its size differs).
metric_descriptions.tstr: Train-synthetic-test-real: model trained on synthetic data, tested on the real holdout.
metric_descriptions.auc_ratio: (TSTR AUC - 0.5) / (TRTR AUC - 0.5) (clipped to [0, 1]); 0 for a classifier without skill.
metric_descriptions.ap_lift_ratio: (TSTR AP - p) / (TRTR AP - p), p = positive rate of the test set (clipped to [0, 1]); 0 for a classifier without skill.
metric_descriptions.f1: F1 of the positive class at a 0.5 probability threshold (reported, not scored).
metric_descriptions.f1_no_skill: F1 of the all-positive classifier, 2p / (1 + p): an F1 at or below it shows no skill.

optimization.name: optimization_utility
optimization.description: Agreement of optimisation decisions made on synthetic vs real ward-days: elective booking quotas (out-of-sample regret on the real holdout), admission-policy evaluation and capacity plans.

booking_quota.name: booking_quota_saa
booking_quota.description: Elective booking quota per ward x weekday by sample average approximation (objective admitted - 2 x cancellations); synthetic and real quotas evaluated out of sample on the real holdout.

policy_evaluation.name: policy_evaluation
policy_evaluation.description: Elective admission-control policies (occupancy target, optional nurse-ratio cap) simulated on real vs synthetic ward-days; score = accuracy of the predicted policy objectives.

capacity_planning.name: capacity_planning
capacity_planning.description: Beds needed per ward = p95 of census_end + emergency_boarders.

metric_descriptions.quota_agreement: Share of ward x weekday groups where the synthetic-optimal quota equals the real-optimal quota.
metric_descriptions.relative_regret: Holdout objective lost by the synthetic-optimal quotas relative to the real-optimal quotas, divided by the holdout objective of the real-optimal quotas (summed over groups; out of sample).
metric_descriptions.in_sample_relative_regret: The same regret evaluated on the training split (the real quota is optimal there).
metric_descriptions.real_decision_regret_vs_oracle: Holdout objective lost by the real-optimal quotas against the holdout optimum (real-vs-real floor of the regret).
metric_descriptions.objective_accuracy: 1 - mean over policies of min(1, |synthetic objective - real objective| / |real objective|).
metric_descriptions.kendall_tau: Kendall rank correlation between the policy rankings on real and on synthetic data (diagnostic).
metric_descriptions.top1_agreement: Whether the best policy on synthetic data is the best policy on real data (diagnostic).
metric_descriptions.kpi_mean_abs_diff: Mean |real - synthetic| over the policy KPI table (rates and occupancy).
metric_descriptions.capacity_relative_error: Mean relative error of the per-ward 95th percentile of census_end + emergency_boarders.

scenario_coverage.name: scenario_coverage
scenario_coverage.description: Ability to generate every catalogue scenario (fulfilment, strata fidelity) and fidelity of each scenario subset to the matching real subset.

scenarios.name: baseline
scenarios.title: Baseline operations
scenarios.description: Unconditional sample reproducing the real mix of wards, seasons and pressures.

scenarios.name: high_occupancy
scenarios.title: High occupancy
scenarios.description: Ward-days at or above 90% midnight occupancy (high or critical band).

scenarios.name: summer_demand
scenarios.title: Summer seasonal demand
scenarios.description: June-August operations (lower emergency demand, reduced August electives).

scenarios.name: emergency_pressure
scenarios.title: Emergency bed pressure
scenarios.description: High-occupancy days with emergency patients still waiting for a bed at midnight.
warnings: Generated 351 of 400 requested rows after 8 attempt(s) (1 condition combination(s) short); the scenario is rare under model 'tvae': increase max_attempts or relax the conditions/filters.
Low acceptance rate (0.7% < 5%): most sampled rows violated hard validation rules or the scenario conditions/filters.

scenarios.name: escalation_capacity
scenarios.title: Escalation beds open under pressure
scenarios.description: High- or critical-occupancy days on which temporary surge (escalation) beds were open (escalation is decided hospital-wide, so on its own it would mostly select winter hub-ward days).

scenarios.name: reduced_capacity
scenarios.title: Reduced bed capacity
scenarios.description: Days with beds closed (staffing, infection control or maintenance).

scenarios.name: scheduled_procedures
scenarios.title: Scheduled procedure days
scenarios.description: Weekday elective lists on surgical and cardiology wards (2+ bookings).
warnings: Generated 389 of 400 requested rows after 8 attempt(s) (1 condition combination(s) short); the scenario is rare under model 'tvae': increase max_attempts or relax the conditions/filters.

scenarios.name: elective_cancellations
scenarios.title: Elective cancellations
scenarios.description: Days on which at least one booked elective admission was cancelled.
warnings: Low acceptance rate (2.7% < 5%): most sampled rows violated hard validation rules or the scenario conditions/filters.

scenarios.name: high_turnover
scenarios.title: High bed turnover (inpatient wards)
scenarios.description: Inpatient-ward days on which at least 30% of available beds were vacated (discharges + transfers out). The acute assessment and children's wards, where rapid turnover is the norm every day, are excluded so the scenario selects busy days rather than ward types.
warnings: Low acceptance rate (3.1% < 5%): most sampled rows violated hard validation rules or the scenario conditions/filters.

scenarios.name: delayed_discharge_pressure
scenarios.title: Delayed discharge pressure
scenarios.description: Days on which 15%+ of inpatients at midnight were medically fit but awaiting discharge.
warnings: Low acceptance rate (1.8% < 5%): most sampled rows violated hard validation rules or the scenario conditions/filters.

108 of 400 rows (27%) were delivered in allocation strata beyond their reference quota because model 'tvae' rarely produces valid rows in the other strata: the output mix is skewed towards the strata the model produces easily.

scenarios.name: staffing_shortage
scenarios.title: Staffing shortage
scenarios.description: Days with nurse staffing below the ward requirement.

scenarios.name: staffing_surplus
scenarios.title: Staffing surplus
scenarios.description: Days with more day-shift nurses than the requirement plus its slack (extra bank or agency cover), the opposite end of the staffing range to staffing_shortage.

metric_descriptions.real_support: Rows (and share) of the real reference data that belong to the scenario.
metric_descriptions.strata_mix_tvd: Total variation distance between the output's allocation-strata mix and the real scenario subset's mix (> 0 when the generator had to move quota to other strata).
metric_descriptions.strata_rounding_tvd: Smallest strata-mix TVD an output of that many rows can reach (rounding floor); the rebalancing flag needs a TVD more than strata_tvd_flag above it.
metric_descriptions.combination_coverage: Share of material real combinations (>= 1% of the real scenario subset) present in the synthetic subset (strata-forced when its columns are allocation strata).
metric_descriptions.weighted_combination_coverage: Share of real scenario rows whose combination appears in the synthetic subset.
metric_descriptions.in_scenario_rate: Share of generated rows that satisfy the scenario's conditions and filters.
metric_descriptions.fidelity: quick_quality score of the synthetic scenario subset against the real scenario subset (allocation-strata columns excluded).
metric_descriptions.kpi_means: Mean of each scenario KPI in real vs synthetic subsets, with relative difference.

model_view.name: model_view
model_view.description: Families re-scored on raw model samples (no rejection, no allocation strata): what the model learned on its own. The composite uses the generator output (system view).

composite.name: composite
composite.description: Weighted sum of fidelity, validity, operational, utility and privacy scores (weights from settings.evaluation.composite_weights, renormalised over the components defined for the table; a failed family scores 0 and marks the composite incomplete).

component_descriptions.fidelity: SDV QualityReport overall score (column shapes + column pair trends).
component_descriptions.validity: Share of raw model samples that pass every hard operational rule.
component_descriptions.operational: Mean score of the occupancy / scheduling / patient-flow pattern checks.
component_descriptions.utility: Mean of ML utility (train-synthetic-test-real) and optimisation utility (decision agreement).
component_descriptions.privacy: Distance-to-closest-record based protection against copying training records.

model_card.description: TVAE (variational autoencoder), global model with every constraint group (SDV built-ins + programmable)
